summary: Master utility asset management and reliability planning to improve uptime, reduce lifecycle cost, and strengthen asset decisions. Enroll today.
lede: Utility asset management and reliability planning provides a structured way to keep essential services running, control lifecycle costs, and support capital decisions with better data and governance. Using ISO 55000, ISO 55001, and reliability-centered maintenance, you will learn to rank critical assets, manage failure risks, and select appropriate maintenance strategies. The course includes practical work on asset registers, criticality matrices, lifecycle cost analysis, CMMS outputs, and reliability KPIs. You will create adaptable planning and reporting materials, including an asset management plan, renewal worksheet, maintenance strategy table, and leadership reporting pack.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for utility professionals who already work with assets, maintenance, operations, or infrastructure planning and need a more disciplined way to manage reliability and renewal.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and access to sample or real asset records if available. A basic CMMS export, maintenance history, or downtime log will make the exercises more relevant, but sample datasets can be used when local records are incomplete.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
